signals.label: Shallow M4.5+ events near nuclear test sites (7 days)
signals.means: A shallow quake near a nuclear test site could be a nuclear or large conventional test.
signals.not_proves: It does not prove a test: natural quakes happen there; only CTBTO or seismologists can tell.

signals.label: FAO Food Price Index (2026-09)
signals.note: baseline = same month a year ago
signals.means: Higher world food prices raise the risk of unrest in import-dependent poor countries.
signals.not_proves: It does not prove unrest: prices follow harvests, weather and currencies.

signals.label: Satellite fire detections near major refineries/oil terminals, European Russia (last 3 days)
signals.note: 13 sites, data to 2026-10-05
signals.series_kind: daily count of VIIRS fire detections within ~15 km of the sites (incl. routine gas flares)
signals.means: More satellite fire detections near big refineries may mean strikes, sabotage or accidents at energy sites.
signals.not_proves: It does not prove an attack or the site hit: gas flaring, field burning and accidents also show as fires.

signals.label: Brent spot price (2026-09-29)
signals.note: baseline = median of the previous 30 trading days

signals.not_proves: It does not prove a physical shortage: speculation, OPEC decisions and the dollar move it too.

signals.label: US commercial crude stocks (ex SPR), week to 2026-09-25
signals.note: baseline = median of the previous 12 weeks; a fall is the warning
signals.series_kind: weekly ending stocks, thousand barrels (one point per week, not daily)
signals.means: Falling US crude or diesel stocks mean a tighter buffer against supply shocks.
signals.not_proves: It does not prove a crisis: stocks move with the season, refinery runs and exports.

signals.not_proves: It does not prove mobilisation: the routine call-up decrees come every spring (late March) and autumn (late September), and many acts are technical.

signals.means: More ads for contract soldiers means the state needs more men than volunteers bring in.

signals.label: Rouble: premium of P2P USDT over the official dollar rate (Bybit vs CBR)
signals.source: Bybit P2P offers vs Bank of Russia rate
signals.means: A rising premium means people pay extra to move money out of roubles: a classic sign of fear of leaving or of controls.
signals.not_proves: Crypto spreads also move with exchange rules, bank blocks and fees.

signals.label: Rouble: official dollar rate (CBR)
signals.means: A sharp fall of the rouble often accompanies capital flight and panic.
signals.not_proves: The rate is managed and moves with oil and policy rates.

signals.note: none of 52 Duma news items in 7 days (duma.gov.ru/news)
signals.source: State Duma (duma.gov.ru news; API when current)
signals.means: The Duma talking publicly about these laws (bills passed, introduced, explained) shows what it is preparing.
signals.not_proves: News is chosen by the Duma press service; one session day can produce several items on one law.

signals.label: Estonia-Russia border: longest daily waiting time for cars heading into Russia (Koidula/Luhamaa, GoSwift)
signals.note: Estonia->Russia (GoSwift): Koidula 347 cars queued; Luhamaa first car slot in 39 d; Luhamaa 330 cars queued; max car wait 132 h on 2026-10-06
signals.means: A sudden jump means the Russian side is processing travellers slowly or more people are crossing: friction at Russia's western land border.
signals.not_proves: Direction is into Russia, not out of it; holidays, Russian checks and staffing move it. Not a count of people leaving Russia. The site does not state the unit; hours is inferred.

signals.label: Estonia-Russia border: 7-day mean of the daily maximum car waiting time (GoSwift)
signals.note: Estonia->Russia (GoSwift): Koidula 347 cars queued; Luhamaa first car slot in 39 d; Luhamaa 330 cars queued; max car wait 132 h on 2026-10-06
signals.means: A sustained rise in waiting time is a slower, steadier sign of tighter Russian border control or heavier traffic.
signals.not_proves: Seasonal travel and Russian processing capacity dominate; not specific to mobilisation.

signals.label: Estonia-Russia border: days until the first free car reservation slot (GoSwift)
signals.note: Estonia->Russia (GoSwift): Koidula 347 cars queued; Luhamaa first car slot in 39 d; Luhamaa 330 cars queued; max car wait 132 h on 2026-10-06
signals.means: When pre-booked slots run weeks ahead, demand to cross far exceeds what the Russian side lets through.
signals.not_proves: Slot horizons depend on how much capacity the system opens for booking.

signals.label: Estonia-Russia border: cars in the full GoSwift queue (live + booked)
signals.note: Estonia->Russia (GoSwift): Koidula 347 cars queued; Luhamaa first car slot in 39 d; Luhamaa 330 cars queued; max car wait 132 h on 2026-10-06
signals.means: More cars queued means more demand to cross into Russia or slower processing.
signals.not_proves: Booked queue includes reservations weeks ahead.

signals.label: Estonia-Russia border: cars let through per day, 7-day mean (GoSwift)
signals.note: Estonia->Russia (GoSwift): Koidula 347 cars queued; Luhamaa first car slot in 39 d; Luhamaa 330 cars queued; max car wait 132 h on 2026-10-06
signals.means: A collapse in throughput with a growing queue means the Russian side is slowing or closing the crossing.
signals.not_proves: Low throughput can be a technical or staffing issue.

signals.label: Georgia: visits by Russian citizens, latest quarter vs same quarter a year earlier (Geostat)
signals.note: Georgia (Geostat): Russian citizens made 126.7k visits/month in 2026 Q2, +5.1% year on year (quarterly, published ~1 month after quarter end)
signals.means: A strong year-on-year rise, as in late 2022, can mean men leaving Russia through Upper Lars.
signals.not_proves: Quarterly and survey-weighted; mostly tourism and family visits; arrives a month or more after the quarter.

signals.label: Georgia: visits by Russian citizens per month, latest quarter average (Geostat)
signals.note: Georgia (Geostat): Russian citizens made 126.7k visits/month in 2026 Q2, +5.1% year on year (quarterly, published ~1 month after quarter end)
signals.means: The level of Russian arrivals in the main nearby visa-free destination.
signals.not_proves: Strongly seasonal (summer peak); compare year on year, not quarter on quarter.

signals.label: Russian garrison courts (panel): new cases of unauthorised leaving of a unit (art. 337), last 28 days, per court
signals.note: 16/16 garrison courts, cases received 2026-09-09..2026-10-06: art.337 175, art.338 10; largest: moskovskygvs.msk 24, 235gvs.msk 22, gvs.ros 21
signals.source: garrison military courts (sudrf.ru), panel of courts without captcha
signals.means: More soldiers prosecuted for leaving their units means the army holds men against their will and morale is eroding; a jump preceded and followed the 2022 mobilisation.
signals.not_proves: Court cards appear with delays and many cases are hidden or never opened (deserters are often sent back to the front instead); a panel of large courts, not all of Russia.

signals.label: Russian garrison courts (panel): new art. 337 cases received, last 28 days
signals.note: 16/16 garrison courts, cases received 2026-09-09..2026-10-06: art.337 175, art.338 10; largest: moskovskygvs.msk 24, 235gvs.msk 22, gvs.ros 21
signals.source: garrison military courts (sudrf.ru), panel of courts without captcha
signals.means: The raw count behind the per-court figure.
signals.not_proves: Changes when panel courts fail to answer; prefer the per-court series.
